envelope.description: Extend the compile-only vscode.d.ts shim with the config API surface

body.title: Extend the compile-only vscode.d.ts shim with the config API surface
body.summary: Add to vscode-plugin/src/vscode.d.ts (no @types/vscode) the minimal ambient declarations sc8's bindings need: workspace.getConfiguration('insrc') returning a WorkspaceConfiguration (get/update/has/inspect), workspace.onDidChangeConfiguration + ConfigurationChangeEvent (affectsConfiguration), and ConfigurationTarget with the Machine member. This gates tsc compile for the extension.ts bindings in t5.
acceptanceChecks: tsc -p vscode-plugin/tsconfig.json compiles the new config API references with no error and no new dependency added
the shim declares workspace.getConfiguration, workspace.onDidChangeConfiguration, ConfigurationChangeEvent, and ConfigurationTarget.Machine

tests.name: tsc -p vscode-plugin/tsconfig.json compiles clean with the extended shim and no @types/vscode dependency
